name: Nu-Goth
garments: minimalist all-black streetwear (fewer lace/velvet flourishes than classic goth)
reacts_against: classic goth's ornate Victorian/medieval references, trading them for a flatter, more minimal, streetwear-adjacent black.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Occult and alchemical symbols, moons, triangles, wide-brimmed hats, harnesses, platform boots, round sunglasses

wiki_facts.key_values: Modernism, minimalism, occultism, internet culture, fashion-forwardness

findings: mostly muted — about 91% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
